answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct server compute slots, ensuring each occupies a unique execution path that remains physically isolated. A central verifier audits these slots using a ferrous probe to detect signal interference, denying any attempt to share capacity. Each agent holds a jade token linked to its specific reservation, proving exclusive occupancy. If a breach occurs, the verifier triggers a lotus-shaped revocation signal, purging the identity.
